purpose: README cover loop. Artwork made from real engine output; not a scientific figure.

scene.data: GenIce2 sII 2x2x2 hydrate crystal (1,088 waters, 3.462 nm cell) analysed by the ClavisCage engine: 1,857 in-cell hydrogen bonds, 192 cages (128 x 5^12 + 64 x 5^12 6^4)
scene.hero: One 5^12 cage found by the engine (20 oxygens, 12 pentagonal faces)
scene.renderer: three.js (WebGL), drawn from the engine output frame by frame

motion.slow: the hero cage turns once per loop
motion.mid: a scan line sweeps the still cell down and up twice per loop
motion.beat: the hero cage lights, its pentagons fill, it lifts out and settles back

type.note: Set live in the page and rendered into the frames; no font file is distributed

runs.text: HYDRATE CAGE ANALYSIS  /  IN THE BROWSER

checks: Each loop passed a determinism, size (<= 2 MiB), motion, seam, title-contrast, legibility and photosensitive-flash audit
